purpose: Generic photographic bar context for all live 3D cocktails; not evidence of any named bar's interior.
method: Built-in image_gen tool; prompt-generated, no supplied images used.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a 2:1 latitude-longitude equirectangular spherical environment panorama for the distant background and reflections of an interactive cocktail photographed on a real countertop.
Create a genuinely photographic, atmospheric generic Singapore cocktail bar interior, empty of people. Dark walnut and muted charcoal interior, restrained shelves of amber and green bottles far in the background, a few soft warm practical lights, a broad neutral warm window glow from the camera-left side. Understated bar, no luxury-hotel cliches. This scene will sit behind real 3D cocktail objects on a rust-red mottled stone countertop. Use the warm brown/rust family with small cream highlights, natural black levels, photographic exposure, not overly orange.
All distant bar details must already have convincing strong optical defocus: soft bottle silhouettes and subtle bokeh, like a real 50mm lens focused on a nearby cocktail. No sharp readable labels. Keep the central front-facing portion calm, darker, with no bright light directly behind the center cocktail. Warm key from left and a restrained cooler soft fill from right. Real photographic material variation, gentle highlight rolloff, no artificial CGI sheen or theatrical beams.
Technical composition: true full 360-degree horizontal by 180-degree vertical equirectangular panorama, exactly 2:1 landscape. Continuous seamless left/right edges, level mid-height horizon. Bottom pole is subdued deep brown floor; top pole dark ceiling. All furnishings several meters away. No close foreground objects, no near tabletop, no cocktails, no drinking glasses, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark. This is a reusable environment map, not a photograph containing the final drink. High resolution 3072 x 1536 preferred.
referenceIntegrity: Contains no cocktail; preserves all interactive drink geometry and source-media evidence.
